rows.source: Markdown remains the only persisted content authority and reload input.
rows.visual: Visual projection edits supported blocks through checked Markdown patches.
rows.finalPreview: Final renders the canonical Markdown through the shared Cherry pipeline.
rows.reader: Reader renders the same canonical Markdown with read-only capabilities.

rows.source: Unknown or untouched source spans remain visible and exportable byte-for-byte.
rows.visual: Raw projection keeps unknown blocks visible without inventing a second authority.
rows.finalPreview: Final preserves sanitized visible raw content without executable markup.
rows.reader: Reader displays the same safe raw content without edit controls.

rows.source: Bold, italic, strike, underline, subscript, superscript, ruby and rich marks retain meaning.
rows.visual: Tiptap marks map to the registered Markdown dialect and preserve selection formatting.
rows.finalPreview: Cherry renders the mark semantics and safe style values.
rows.reader: Reader renders the same mark semantics without author actions.

rows.source: Heading levels and block quote source syntax remain canonical.
rows.visual: Visual exposes native heading and contextual quote structure.
rows.finalPreview: Final renders headings, anchors and block quote structure.
rows.reader: Reader keeps headings, anchors and quote reading navigation.

rows.source: Ordered, unordered and task list Markdown remains round-trippable.
rows.visual: Visual uses native list and task item editing semantics.
rows.finalPreview: Final renders list markers and checked task state.
rows.reader: Reader displays list and task state without mutation events.

rows.source: Cherry panel variants and source payloads remain portable Markdown.
rows.visual: Visual presents a semantic node with its bounded editing route.
rows.finalPreview: Final renders sanitized panel title/body and variant semantics.
rows.reader: Reader presents panel content and reading controls only.

rows.source: Two-column, multi-column, tabs, accordion and timeline source stays authoritative.
rows.visual: Visual exposes structured layout nodes and local editing controls.
rows.finalPreview: Final renders layout/disclosure content through the shared safe path.
rows.reader: Reader keeps layout reading interactions while omitting author mutation.

rows.source: Paragraph alignment is preserved in the Markdown dialect.
rows.visual: Visual alignment state maps to the checked source range.
rows.finalPreview: Final applies sanitized alignment classes and styles.
rows.reader: Reader displays the same aligned content.

rows.source: Pipe tables, delimiters and one-time sort results remain Markdown authority.
rows.visual: Visual uses Tiptap table structure and commits bounded patches.
rows.finalPreview: Final renders the table through Cherry table semantics.
rows.reader: Reader displays table structure without edit or mutation events.

rows.source: Chart table declarations and data/options remain portable source.
rows.visual: Visual exposes the chart semantic node and its data editor.
rows.finalPreview: Shared hydration validates dataset values before ECharts mount.
rows.reader: Reader keeps chart output and safe chart reading surface.

rows.source: Fenced code and language info strings remain exact Markdown.
rows.visual: Visual directly edits code and uses session-only fold/highlight state.
rows.finalPreview: Shared code enhancement adds copy/fold and author edit actions.
rows.reader: Shared code enhancement adds copy/fold but no edit action.

rows.source: Mermaid fenced source remains visible and editable in source Markdown.
rows.visual: Visual shows a semantic Mermaid node with local rendering/error state.
rows.finalPreview: Shared Mermaid hydration validates and renders sanitized SVG previews.
rows.reader: Reader shows Mermaid SVG when hydration succeeds and a bounded error otherwise.

rows.source: Inline and block KaTeX source remains Markdown authority.
rows.visual: Visual exposes formula nodes with the existing dedicated picker.
rows.finalPreview: Shared sanitizer rehydrates formulas through the safe KaTeX renderer.
rows.reader: Reader keeps inline/block formulas without exposing author controls.

rows.source: TOC source and heading anchors remain derived from Markdown.
rows.visual: Visual represents TOC as a navigable semantic node.
rows.finalPreview: Final renders the TOC and stable heading anchors.
rows.reader: Reader keeps TOC and anchor navigation.

rows.source: URL media and attachment metadata remain Markdown fields.
rows.visual: Visual uses semantic media/attachment nodes and host upload policy.
rows.finalPreview: Final sanitizes URL media and attachment links.
rows.reader: Reader displays supported URL media and attachments without upload/edit entry.

rows.source: PNG data URL plus URI-encoded mxfile XML remain the sole authority.
rows.visual: Visual routes draw.io edits through the controlled bridge and one patch.
rows.finalPreview: Final renders the portable PNG preview from the shared safe output.
rows.reader: Reader shows the PNG and never initializes the author editor bridge.

rows.source: Search matches are derived from current Markdown and replacements are explicit edits.
rows.visual: Visual decorations do not become persisted content.
rows.finalPreview: Final search decorations operate on rendered text only.
rows.reader: Reader remains content-read-only while navigation/search is allowed.

rows.source: Theme and line spacing are presentation settings, not Markdown fields.
rows.visual: Visual consumes resolved settings for editing presentation.
rows.finalPreview: Final consumes the same resolved theme/font/line-height context.
rows.reader: Reader consumes the resolved reading theme and line spacing.

rows.source: Mode changes and saves do not rewrite Markdown or clear session history.
rows.visual: Visual keeps native history inside the mounted document session.
rows.finalPreview: Final derives from the current revision and has no edit history.
rows.reader: Reader has no document mutation/history surface.
